name: 3D Print Timelapse Gallery
short_desc: 3D print timelapse history with G-code pairing — filter by filament, printer, outcome, tags
author: cori
description: Browsable timelapse gallery for 3D prints. Each entry pairs a timelapse video (MP4) with its source G-code file. Reads metadata from manifest.json containing print details (filament, printer, outcome, duration, tags). Features filter pills by filament (PLA/PETG/PCTG), printer (plus4/k1), outcome (success/failed/cancelled), and custom tags. Watch page shows video player with poster frame, print metadata, G-code download link, and clickable tag chips linking to filtered gallery.

form_fields.label: Refresh Interval (seconds)
form_fields.hint: How often to re-scan for new timelapse files. 300 = 5 min.

form_fields.label: Public Domain
form_fields.hint: Public domain for OpenGraph/Twitter Card URLs (e.g., prints.407.lol)
